title.en: An Act to Appropriate the Sum of Twenty-Eight thousand Pesos Out of Any Funds in the Insular Treasury Not Otherwise Appropriated, for the Construction of a Provincial Jail in the Province of Surigao.

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise
appropriated, the sum of twenty-eight thousand pesos, which shall be turned over to the provincial board of
Surigao for the construction of a provincial jail at the capital of said province.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 28, 1919.
